candidates.algorithm: Parse each formula with openpyxl tokenizer; relativize R1C1-style offsets per anchor; group cells by (sheet, normalized pattern). Report families with >=3 members + singletons adjacent to a family.
candidates.counterevidence: Historical fingerprint-as-program-choice authority claim FALSIFIED; family membership must not imply intent.
candidates.description: Cells sharing the same relative formula pattern (normalized R1C1 translation class).
candidates.discovery_path: Agent prints a formula column/row and eyeballs repetition, or copies one exemplar's formula.
candidates.overreach_risk: MEDIUM if framed as repair authority; LOW as evidence listing.

candidates.algorithm: Within each relative family, flag members whose formula text differs from the family pattern while neighbors match; separate input-state singletons from post-edit breaks by comparing input vs output workbooks.
candidates.counterevidence: Legitimate edge formulas (totals, headers) break families by design; input-state breaks are usually intentional.
candidates.description: A cell whose formula deviates from its row/column family's pattern.
candidates.discovery_path: Agent reads the outlier cell directly, or never looks because neighbors look fine.
candidates.overreach_risk: MEDIUM: input-state breaks are often legitimate; post-edit breaks are stronger.

candidates.algorithm: For each formula cell, compare error-valuedness between input stored values and output stored values (and recalc artifacts where present). Report cells error-valued in output but not input, with error type.

cost_estimate.complexity: value comparison; recalc needed for full precision

candidates.counterevidence: Stored cached values may be stale without recalc; CONDITIONAL on recalc-or-cache trust.
candidates.description: Formula cells newly evaluating to an error (#REF!, #VALUE!, #DIV/0!, #NAME?, #N/A, #NUM!, #NULL!) after the agent's edits.
candidates.discovery_path: Agent reopens output in LibreOffice, or prints values and notices error strings.
candidates.input_state: Input + output workbooks (+ recalc where available).
candidates.overreach_risk: LOW: error presence is mechanical; repair choice stays with model.

candidates.algorithm: Parse date-valued/period-labeled header cells (shared strings, date formats, FY/Q strings); align columns to period coordinates; report header->period map and historical/forecast block boundaries where mechanically unambiguous.
candidates.counterevidence: Ambiguous headers (two-digit years, missing FY anchors) require judgment; CONDITIONAL on unambiguous parse.
candidates.description: Mapping from header/date cells to period coordinates (FY, quarter, month index) and block boundaries.
candidates.discovery_path: Agent prints header row and parses dates ad hoc.
candidates.overreach_risk: MEDIUM: period semantics shade into intent; keep to mechanical alignment.

candidates.algorithm: Detect repeated columnar/block output slots: columns/blocks whose formulas are translations of each other AND whose positions repeat across sheets/blocks; report role-equivalent sets.
candidates.counterevidence: Historical planner effects were narrow; repetition may be coincidental layout.
candidates.description: Cells in different blocks/columns serving the same structural output role (e.g. analogous subtotal columns).
candidates.discovery_path: Agent scrolls/views each block separately and may miss the analogy.
candidates.overreach_risk: HIGH if framed as target authority; LOW as analogy evidence.

candidates.algorithm: Tokenize formulas; extract direct precedent refs (same-sheet + cross-sheet); build one-hop precedent/dependent lists per cell. No transitive closure by default.
candidates.counterevidence: dependency-as-intent authority FALSIFIED; precedent facts must not imply targets.
candidates.description: Direct precedent/dependent cell sets per formula cell.
candidates.discovery_path: Agent traces precedents by reading formula text manually.
candidates.input_state: Pre-action workbook (+ output for changed deps).
candidates.overreach_risk: MEDIUM: must stay diagnostic, never target authority.

candidates.algorithm: For each formula, list referenced cells whose current value is blank/None; diff input vs output to flag references that BECAME blank (populated->blank) or chains broken by deletion.
candidates.counterevidence: Blank references are often legitimate (sparse inputs, optional fields); newly-broken is stronger than statically-blank.
candidates.description: Formulas referencing blank cells, especially references that became blank after edits.
candidates.discovery_path: Agent rarely enumerates reference blankness; usually encounters via downstream error.
candidates.overreach_risk: LOW as delta; MEDIUM as static list (noisy).

candidates.algorithm: Diff input vs output at cell level (value/formula presence); report: formula changed while family neighbors unchanged; populated region became blank; region became nonuniform.
candidates.counterevidence: Most changes are the task itself; value is in the UNINTENDED remainder.
candidates.description: Structural characterization of what changed between input and output workbooks.
candidates.discovery_path: Agent re-reads edited region; rarely diffs systematically.
candidates.overreach_risk: LOW: describes agent's own action footprint.

candidates.algorithm: Enumerate merged ranges per sheet; list cells covered; flag formula cells inside merged ranges and reads of non-top-left merged children.
candidates.description: Merged-range membership per cell (D0-adjacent control candidate: expected ALREADY REACHED or irrelevant).
candidates.discovery_path: Agent views sheet; merged cells visible in dumps.

candidates.algorithm: List all formula cells as (coordinate, formula text) pairs per sheet.
candidates.description: Full formula inventory (control candidate: agents do this constantly).
candidates.discovery_path: Ubiquitous: print formulas via openpyxl loops.

discovery_slots: Agent-invented scans/groupings mined from transcripts (patterns: set(), sorted(set()), regex over formulas, Counter, groupby, dateutil parsing, zipfile inspection).
